m: {Sherlock} crouches in {Front} of the {Tower} with his magnifying glass and deduces, from one singed crumb, that a tiny *emperor* has lit a *campfire* by the drawbridge. "Elementary," he says, tilting the lens, and his own focused sunbeam makes the evidence **burn**. The emperor's paper crown starts to **burn**, the flagpole follows, and Watson trots behind with a very small bucket.

{James Bond} adjusts his bow tie in the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} and tests Q's latest gadget: a *set square* that shouts the **distance** to anything it points at. A spring-loaded *kicking foot* pops out of his shoe and boots it through the door, past the mummies. "Four hundred metres," it calls faintly, and Bond, unruffled, remarks that he prefers to keep his **distance**.

{Cookie Monster} thunders {Inside} the {Island} palace, googly eyes spinning, and spears a velvet *robe* on a jousting *lance*. "Me **cut out** cookie shape!" he roars, chewing a perfect round hole through the cloth in a spray of crumbs. He holds it up, sees the moon through the gap, and goes on to **cut out** stars, hearts and one wobbly gingerbread man with his teeth.

{Pikachu} scampers in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange}, where a *standing person* is hanging a heavy *nameboard* above the door. "Pika!" he squeaks, and a Thunderbolt snaps the left-hand hook, so the board starts to **lean**. The person tilts to hold it up, the lamp post sags, and soon the whole street has to **lean** over, with small yellow sparks skipping down the slope.

{Frodo} plods wearily {Inside} the {Pool} on bare hairy feet, and a *cashier* behind a *bamboo* till demands a ticket. He has only the Ring, which glows and traces a fiery **sign** across the water, and the cashier stamps it nervously. Now every locker door shows the same **sign**, the swimmers back away, and Sam whispers that perhaps they should have walked round.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} hut, where a tiny *man* faces a snoring sea monster with nothing but a silver *hairpin*. Yoshi swallows the little fellow whole, thinks it over, and lays him back out as a spotted egg. Out he hatches, **brave** as ever, and jabs the *hairpin* at the monster's nose; it flees squeaking, and Yoshi licks the **brave** little man's cheek.

{Charlie Brown} trudges into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} holding an *ox horn*, and a shiny green *bug* settles on its tip. He reaches out for one gentle **touch** and, naturally, it sparks, zapping him until his zigzag shirt stands on end. "Good grief," says Charlie, who cannot **touch** a kite, a football or even an insect without disaster.

{Kermit} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut}, arms flailing, to stage-manage today's **lesson**, but the whole class is one *small speech bubble* and a heap of *fruit*. The bubble floats up and squeaks "apple!" while the pears roll away and a banana dives into the tub. "Yaaay!" he shrieks, strumming his banjo, because the **lesson** must go on.

{James Bond} glides through the {Bathroom} of the {Boxing Ring} without a crease in his tuxedo, and Q's wristwatch fires out a tiny arm that snaps up in a crisp *salute*. The champion salutes back, the towels stand to attention and the soap bows in **respect**. Bond, unruffled, straightens his cuffs and says that his bow tie never comes undone, which earns him even more **respect**.

{Kermit} sits in {Front} of the {Pool} and strums his banjo, singing how hard it is to be green, so sadly that a *dog* stops its cheerful *chatter* and begins to **cry**. Its howls fill the drainpipe, so he flails his arms and yells for everybody to take their places. It is no use: the lifeguards, the ducks and finally Kermit himself all **cry** into the deep end.

{Darth Vader} stalks into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} hut, breathing loudly, where a film *director* is shouting at a *standing heart* that will not act. Vader raises one glove and lifts the pair into the air with the Force until the heart gives a nervous thump and begins to **understand**. "Now you **understand**," he booms, and the director, still floating, nods very fast and rewrites the ending.

{Chewbacca} storms {Inside} the {Stadium} and finds a *miser* patting together a **wall** of *soil*, one mean spoonful at a time, so nobody can watch the game for free. He lets out a long furious roar that only friends understand and rips the **wall** apart in a temper. Then, feeling bad, he welds it back together with ship parts, and the miser charges him a coin.

{Shrek} sits grumpily {Inside} the {Beach} house peeling an onion, wishing to be left alone, when a *dragon* in a silk *robe* swoops down on a **raid**. It grabs every towel, while Donkey, naturally, asks it to dinner. Shrek roars so hard that the robe blows off, then declares a **raid** of his own on its sandcastles, just so that everyone will go away.

The {Joker} pops up in the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} with a huge grin and squirts his flower at a *town crier*, whose bell starts to ring by itself. "I **summon** the horses!" cackles the Joker, flicking out trick cards that turn into tiny invitations. Three hundred horses in party hats squeeze up the stairs, and he winds the bell tighter to **summon** three hundred more.

{Frodo} limps {Inside} the {Spa} after a very long walk and, tempted by the Ring, slips it on to dodge paying. An invisible hobbit is no match for the *fishing net* that drops from above: the manager hauls him up, dripping, to **punish** him. Every wriggle dunks his hairy feet in the hot tub, and Sam, loyal as ever, asks to be the next one they **punish**.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Piazza} wanting only quiet, but a *standing person* bursts through the crowd with blacksmith's *tongs*, snapping them at his nose and shouting that every **hero** must slay an ogre. Shrek just roars him, tongs and all, into the fountain. Donkey, who will not shut up, tells the whole square that the town's new **hero** is a grumpy one who smells of onions.

{Tarzan} swings in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring} on a vine and gives his jungle yell, and the echo booms back from a vast stone **hall** carved into a *cliff*. Baffled by civilisation, he hangs his vine on the only *nail*, which pings out and rattles round the walls for ten minutes. His apes march in and declare the **hall** an excellent place to shout.

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Island} hut, cape spread, and a crowd of crabs each raise one *shading hand* to peer up at him. Then they **bow**, claws to the tiles. Gruff and suspicious, he checks the floor with a gadget from his belt, finds nothing, and growls that he will not **bow** back, until his cape catches on a hook and bends him double.

{Chewbacca} squeezes into the {Basement} of the {Cat Café}, where a broken starship engine sits on a *workbench*. Huge hairy fingers that rip doors apart turn out to be **skilful** as a watchmaker's: one *puff of breath* clears the dust, two growls set the gears spinning, and the engine purrs. The cats stare at the **skilful** giant, then bring him all their broken wind-up mice.

{Cookie Monster} tumbles into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut}, where a *standing person* reads from a huge *rulebook*: cookies stay on the left **side** of the sink. His googly eyes roll, and "Me want cookie!" he bellows, gobbling that whole half in a spray of crumbs. Then he eats the *rulebook*, and the other **side** of the sink as well.

{Homer} dozes {Inside} the {Mansion} until *dawn* bursts through a window that looks out on **Korea**, all mountains and kimchi jars. "Mmm…" he drools at a stall selling sweet rice doughnuts, and his dim scheme is to lasso them with a *leather strap*. It snags and yanks him through the window, and "D'oh!" he says, landing face first in **Korea**.

{Mario} leaps up in the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} and head-butts a block, and out pops not a coin but a *brimmed hat*. He stomps on it with a "Wahoo!" and it starts to **emit** steam, then coins, then a stream of bubbles from under the brim. He stomps again, but every stomp only makes it **emit** more, until the taps are buried and he floats upward on his moustache.

The {Joker} bursts into the {Bathroom} of the {Island} hut, where a *debt collector* is chasing a *standing person* with a giant bill. Grinning, he offers to settle the **debt** with a trick playing card, and the card squirts water in the collector's face. The bill flutters over to the Joker, who cackles, signs it in custard and passes the **debt** on to a passing crab.

{Mario} bounds into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} with a "Wahoo!" and stomps on a *long veil* left hanging over the bath. It flies up and floats him down, spinning, as **graceful** as a swan. Every jump tips a coin out of the folds, each landing is slower and more **graceful** than the last, and soon the plumber is pirouetting across the taps on one boot.

{Robocop} marches stiffly {Inside} the {Lagoon} hut, visor glowing, and reads a *bug* its rights for stirring a *cauldron* without a permit. His targeting display flashes a warning as the steam rises, and his knees begin to **melt**. "Directive four," he says, sinking, "no citizen may **melt** an officer," and he arrests the *bug* very politely from a silver puddle.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond} exactly when he means to, as he does every day, pipe lit and robes dripping. A swan in a *string of coins* hisses, he taps his staff to make it jingle a tune, and his *standing heart*, hopping along beside him, does not even skip. "You get **used to** it," he mutters; after centuries of wizardry you get **used to** anything.

{Shrek} shuffles into the {Basement} of the {Stadium} to hide from the noise and finds a *feast* of onions, slugs and swamp soup laid out just for him. Alone at last, he belches a happy roar and starts to **enjoy** it, layer by layer. Then Donkey trots in, talking nonstop, and Shrek stuffs an onion in his mouth so he can **enjoy** the silence too.

{Darth Vader} sweeps into the {Bathroom} of the {Island} hut, breathing loudly, and with the Force lifts a *lance* that carries a *strange mask* on its tip. He floats the mask down and, disapproving of everything else on the shelf, clamps it over his helmet to **wear** it. It fits badly, his breathing now whistles through its nose, and he booms at the towels that they too will **wear** one.

{Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Lagoon} hut on a vine, where a *schoolkid* sits doing homework. Raised by apes, he decides this small **child** must be a lost baby gorilla, tucks the **child** under one arm and gives his jungle yell. The *schoolkid* giggles and hangs on, and they sail off over the water while a monkey finishes the maths.

{Yoshi} sits {Inside} the {Boathouse} when a *prowling dog* comes sniffing after the *wart* on his nose. His tongue whips out, swallows the dog, and he lays it as a spotted egg, then sits on it **as if** nothing has happened. The egg barks. Yoshi gazes out of the window, **as if** eggs bark every day, and the wart wobbles with the effort of not laughing.

{Charlie Brown} trudges {Inside} the {Jungle} with his kite, and a *rider* on an elephant shouts that he may **ride** too. He climbs up, good grief, and the elephant instantly sits down, then stands up the moment he slides off. Every time he tries to **ride**, it happens again, while Snoopy rolls past on a tortoise, looking smug.

{Gandalf} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Water Park} clutching a *jade tablet* and taps his staff, whereupon a magic *helping hand* shoots out of the plughole. It tries to **hang** the tablet on a wet hook, but it slides off. Muttering a cranky spell, he makes the tablet float up and **hang** in mid-air, along with his pointy hat and most of his beard.

{James Bond} saunters into the {Basement} of the {Stadium}, where a *big man* guards a golden trophy, the grand **prize**. Bond clicks a cufflink from Q that does one absurd thing: it swaps whatever it points at for a rubber chicken. The *big man* now hugs the chicken, and Bond strolls off, unruffled, with the real **prize** under his arm and one eyebrow raised.

{Sherlock} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} and, with one look at the *silk thread* on a *town crier*'s sleeve, deduces everybody's entire life. The crier ties the thread from guest to guest and begs him to **introduce** them. "Elementary," he says with a smug puff of his pipe, and he begins to **introduce** each stranger by their secrets, while Watson trails behind, apologising.

{Homer} waddles into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} holding a doughnut as **thick** as a mattress, his dim scheme for never being hungry again. A small *child* asks for a bite and cannot get her teeth through the icing. "Mmm…" says Homer, eating deeper until he is wedged in it to the ears, and the **thick** ring jams him in the door with a "D'oh!"

{Zorro} swings into the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon} hut and slashes his rapier straight up the wall, drawing only the long **vertical** stroke of a Z. A *silk thread* falls from the cut, and a *follower* in a small mask climbs it hand over hand. Zorro tugs the thread stiff and **vertical** as a flagpole, laughs, and vanishes upward past him.

The {Joker} skips into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} and finds his way stopped by a *hillside* that has slid in overnight, with a guard on top flashing a shiny *badge* to **block** him. He cackles and squirts his flower, and the badge spins round to show a smiley face. The guard tries to **block** him again, but steps on a whoopee cushion and rolls down the slope.

{Shrek} hides in the {Bathroom} of the {Dunes} hut, wanting peace, but a *swift* dives through the window with a *small speech bubble* in its beak. It bursts above his head with terrible **news**: Donkey has found him. Shrek roars, which only brings Donkey galloping in with more **news**, and he will not shut up about any of it.

{Sherlock} examines the {Bathroom} of the {Hut}, ankle-deep in *water drops*, and deduces from one damp crumb that the tap was left on by a left-handed sailor. He must **wade** across with his violin held high, testing every *step* with his magnifying glass. "Elementary," he says as the floor drops away, and Watson, trailing behind, has to **wade** after him, carrying the pipe.

{Charlie Brown} trudges into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} leaving muddy *footsteps* and decides, for once, to clean up in a **thorough** way. He scrubs every tile, and at last makes one proud *cut* through the tangled kite string in the drain. That string was holding the pipes together, good grief, and the flood is so **thorough** that it washes the zigzag off his shirt.

{Kermit} stands in {Front} of the {Mansion}, flailing his arms at a chaos of wet newspapers on a *drying rack*, because the show's paper must **publish** tonight. A *standing knife* hops along trimming every page crooked. "Yaaay!" he yells, tossing armfuls at the crowd, and he hops on the rack to **publish** a new edition every hour, each one just a picture of him panicking.

The {Joker} prances into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} leaning on an old *walking staff*, then flips it over to reveal a trigger with a huge grin painted on it. He presses it and, with a rude honk, the staff shoots up **ten feet**, carrying his purple hat to the rafters. A little flag pops out reading **ten feet**, and he cackles as he jumps for it.

{Batman} grapples into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} and finds a *campfire* crackling in the tub, with a *heatwave* pouring off it. In the heat his batarangs begin to **explode** with little pops of black confetti. "Stay calm," he growls, as the utility belt itself starts to **explode**, shooting grappling hooks and one very small Batmobile out through the window.

{Walter White} sets up a class experiment in {Front} of the {Pool}, beakers gleaming, to turn one black *crow* perfectly white. He pours his precise mixture and, with a fizz, the **crow** turns shocking pink while the class gasps. Proud and furious, he corrects the ratio by one drop, and now the **crow** is blacker than his hat, cawing at him for marks.

{Yoshi} flutters into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} hut, where a sergeant waves a *war club* at a mountain of wet sand and shouts for hard **labour**. Muddy *footsteps* march away from the job, so Yoshi does it his way: he swallows the sand in huge licks and lays it out as neat egg after egg. Hours of **labour** later, the whole beach has been rebuilt in spots.

{Mario} bounces {Inside} the {Cat Café} and head-butts a block, and out drop a coin and a sheet of thin paper. A *helping hand* lays it over a tray of *young crop* seedlings and starts to **trace** every leaf. "Wahoo!" he shouts, stomping the table, and each stomp jolts the pencil, so it must **trace** them all again, this time with a moustache on every sprout.

{Shrek} stamps into the {Basement} of the {Beach} house and finds a muddy *front runner* from the marathon dripping on his carefully kept swamp slime. Furious, he roars so hard that *water drops* burst from the pipes, and he grabs a sponge to **wash** the man. Layer by layer, like an onion, he has to **wash** off the mud, while Donkey keeps asking if he may be next.

{Mario} drops through a warp pipe into the {Basement} of the {Spa}, where a *king* sits on a *horse* in a mud bath. He jumps up, head-butts the floating block above them, and instead of a coin out pops a striped **agate**. The *horse* snorts, the *king* claps for more, and with a "Wahoo!" he keeps bashing until one glossy **agate** after another pings into the mud.

{Homer} waddles into the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond} eating a *kebab* snatched from a swan's picnic, while his *heart* thumps in protest. "Mmm…" he says, and then he begins to **suffer**, with a stomach ache as wide as the pond. His dim cure is a second kebab. "D'oh!" he moans, and the *heart* goes on making him **suffer** while the swans line up to watch.

{Mario} bounces into the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café} and finds a *woman* dusting a mushroom with a *pinch* of golden powder. He gulps it, grows to the size of a wardrobe and shouts "Wahoo!", and everything turns **wonderful**: coins rain from the taps and cats surf his moustache. The woman adds another *pinch*, and the day gets so **wonderful** that even the soap applauds.

{James Bond} steps into the {Bathroom} of the {Boxing Ring} for the grand *finale*, and Q's bow tie flicks open into a shiny **mirror**. In it he spots a thug creeping up behind him. He flips a handful of *gold coins* at the glass, they ricochet past his ear and bop the thug on the nose, and Bond, never turning round, smooths his hair in the **mirror**.

{Charlie Brown} mopes into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} and opens his *mouth* to **sing** for the school concert, and of course it goes wrong: a *double sun* blazes through the window and both suns boo him. He tries one sad little note. Good grief, Snoopy dances on the sink, the suns start to **sing** louder, and Charlie gets the only part with no words.

{Frodo} limps {Inside} the {Mansion} after walking for months and sits by a *campfire* on the landing, only to have a *page* of Sam's endless poem flutter out and stick to his face. He peels it off, weary and **annoyed**, and another lands. Even the Ring feels **annoyed**, and whispers that it could make him invisible to poetry.

{Chewbacca} looms in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange}, where an *assembly* of bankers holds out *bamboo* pens and begs him to **sign** a loan for his broken ship. He roars a long roar only friends understand, snaps every pen in his huge fist and, for want of ink, presses one hairy paw to the contract. Now all the bankers must **sign** with paw prints too.

{Shrek} stomps in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} to complain about a *standing person* floating over the *mountain* behind it, eating clouds. "I am **immortal**," says the old man, "and I will never leave you alone." Shrek roars, which only ruffles the old man's robes, and he groans that an **immortal** neighbour is even worse than Donkey.

{Batman} prowls into the {Basement} of the {Beach} house, following sandy *footsteps* to a heap of buckets with an old *hide* draped over them. He sweeps his detective scanner across and growls, "Not this clue, **that** one." He fires his grappling hook over there, the *hide* flaps up, and nothing is under it. "No," he growls, pointing further away, "**that** one."

{Frodo} plods {Inside} the {Pool} on sore hairy feet, and a giant *dollar sign* blocks the ladder and shakes itself: **not** today. He slips on the Ring and vanishes, tiptoeing past, but it rings like a till and sniffs him out. It booms that **not** even an invisible hobbit swims free, so weary Frodo sits down on the edge with Sam.

The {Joker} prances into the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle} clinic, wheels a *sickbed* up to a chalk *goal line*, and declares that a monkey has a terrible **illness**: laughing fits. He pins a squirting flower on its chest and shows a trick card as the chart. The monkey giggles so hard it rolls over the line, and everybody catches the silly **illness**, cackling till the palm trees shake.

{Frodo} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, and a *standing person* starts to **imitate** every weary step, even the hairy-footed limp. Frodo slips on the Ring and vanishes, so the copycat holds up a cardboard *square* and hides behind it. The *square* sighs when he sighs. Sam wanders in, cannot tell whom to follow, and ends up trying to **imitate** them both.

{Chewbacca} stomps in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring} and finds a *standing person* with a *tilted head*, peering at the ring he has just repaired with ship parts. Insulted, he yanks out one bolt with a roar, and the whole arena begins to **tilt**. The boxers slide, the crowd slides, and the person just smiles, since at last everything shares the same **tilt** as his neck.

{Pikachu} bounces {Inside} the {Island} hut with a *wood slice* on his back, and a Thunderbolt scorches letters into it, making a smoking **sign board** that reads PIKA. A big paper *fan* flaps it cool, and he hangs it up. Trainers come to read it and throw a Poké Ball at him, so he sparks out and points proudly at the next **sign board**: PIKA again.

{Shrek} sneaks into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange}, hoping for a moment alone, but a *hillside* of coins gives way under his feet and drops him into a *trap pit*. He roars, and the **trap** only sinks deeper. Donkey leans over the edge and starts to chat, and Shrek realises that the real **trap** is that he cannot get away from him.

{Naruto} bursts into the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} in his orange jumpsuit, promising to save one tiny *bird* from the prowling cats. With a loud shout he makes a hundred shadow clones, every one flapping and squawking as a decoy **bird**. The cats pounce in a heap, each clone vanishes with a pop, and the real **bird** perches on his headband, unimpressed.

{Homer} naps in {Front} of the {Lagoon} hut when a runaway *cart* rolls up, full of doughnut-shaped fireworks. He grabs one with *both hands*, thinks "Mmm…" and takes a bite. A huge **bang** flings him across the water with a "D'oh!", and another **bang** sends the cart spinning skywards, with all the fish leaping up to watch.

{Zorro} swings on a chandelier {Inside} the {Mansion}, masked and laughing, and slashes a giant Z into the curtains. Out of the slash pop a talking *mouth* and a sniffing *nose*, who shout that **we** all ride with him now. He sweeps his cape round them, the butler and the black horse, laughs that **we** are all masked tonight, and vanishes, taking everyone along.

{Cookie Monster} crashes into the {Bathroom} of the {Island} hut, where a *fruit picker* is plucking cabbages from *grass* growing out of the tub. "Eat your **vegetable**," says the picker, so Cookie Monster shouts "Me want cookie!" and crunches a carrot by mistake in a spray of orange crumbs. His googly eyes spin in horror, and he lets out a small wail: "Me just eat **vegetable**."

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} hut, where a tiny *green shoot* has wedged an iron *gate* ajar. He fires his grappling hook, hauls, and the *gate* slams with a boom to **close** on his cape. Brooding in the dark, pinned at the neck, he decides to **close** his eyes and pretend that this was the plan.

{Frodo} limps into the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair}, whose back door opens on a muddy *rice field* where a *big man* is stuck up to his knees. Weary and reluctant, Frodo takes the next step anyway, because that is how hobbits **strive**: one hairy foot after another, for months. The *big man* is shamed into pulling free and starts to **strive** too, and Sam ends up carrying them both.

{Chewbacca} bursts into the {Bathroom} of the {Boxing Ring}, roaring with joy because his ship has flown at last, and lifts a *big man* clean off the floor in a hairy hug. Then he rips a *shed* apart with his bare hands for confetti, because that is how he likes to **celebrate**. The *big man* cheers, splinters rain down, and everyone must **celebrate** until his crossbow fires a streamer.

{Charlie Brown} runs into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} for the kick of his life, with the football waiting on the sink. At the last second a *helping hand* pulls it back, as it does every time, and he flies past it. "Good grief," he groans from the floor, as the hand starts to **withdraw** the towels and the soap as well, and all his hopes **withdraw** through the door.

{Lara Croft} climbs down into the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} and finds an ancient stone *eye* guarding a relic behind a locked door. Its lid trickles *water drops*, and she works out that the lock opens only when the bowl beneath is full of **tears**. She tells it a very sad story, ponytail swinging, and as the door grinds open she backflips over a flood of **tears**.

{Charlie Brown} sits {Inside} the {Spa} hoping someone will share his **tea**, but with his luck the only leaves he can find are *grass* clippings from the lawn. Good grief: the kettle whistles, the *grass* swells up and bursts out of the spout, and Lucy pulls the cup away just as he reaches for it. Snoopy drinks his **tea**, of course.

{James Bond} lounges {Inside} the {Beach} house, tuxedo spotless, in spite of a blazing *fever*. Q's pocket gadget diagnoses any **disease** and does one absurd thing: it inflates the patient's bow tie. The tie swells up and floats him out over the sand, and he remarks, unruffled, that this **disease** is at least going places.

{Yoshi} pads {Inside} the {Mint} and spots a *hog* trailing a red *silk thread*, so out shoots his sticky tongue and down goes the pig. He lays it as an egg, but the thread still runs from the shell to his own toe. It must be **fate**: he flutter-jumps, he runs, and the egg bounces after him, until the *hog* hatches and moves in, bound to him by **fate**.

{Batman} lands in {Front} of the {Fort} and loads a belt gadget that shoots seeds like tiny batarangs across a *footprint field*, while a mechanical *helping hand* tucks each one into a print. He growls that if you **sow** a clue in every footprint, the sunflowers will lead you to the culprit. By morning a bat-shaped hedge stands there, and he broods off to **sow** the next field.

{Lara Croft} vaults into the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, where an ancient puzzle says the hidden door opens only to the full *moon*. She climbs a wall, ponytail flying, and twists a bronze mirror until the *moon* pours through a crack and the room goes **bright** as noon. It gets so **bright** that a stone idol seems to squint, and the door slides open.

{Darth Vader} looms in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, breathing loudly, where a *tree* is bursting up through the tiles in a fountain of *soil*. He raises one glove and Force-chokes the trunk until its leaves freeze in mid-air. "You will **stop**," he booms, and it does. With one more twitch of his fingers he makes the taps, the echoes and even the drips **stop** as well.

{Naruto} crashes into the {Basement} of the {Island} hut demanding ramen, and a *woman* hands him a coconut tied with a *ribbon*, full of **milk** instead.
